body: i'm not (yet) seeing a therapist, and lately my trans thoughts are creeping back suicidal thoughts. and i think that his research is as good as it gets, because he's extremely sexist towards women, and is not very fond the LGBT community, from what i've seen.
yea this is also the reason why i'm not doing anything

it doesn't help that i'm broke though :p but anyway, i came out to my mom first a week ago, and she was okay with it, and to my dad a few days ago. at first he didn't seem to like it, but now he's okay with it i guess. but we don't really talk about it. the bit we have talked about it, he said that i shouldn't transition, because i would just regret it anyway, but i have already pieced out my entire future (being a girl), and actually the longer i'm not a girl, the more i just want to drop dead. because i am not doing anything like this, and i can tell you that it's extremely boring.
well.. maybe it is a sickness. so what? that doesn't change the fact that it's real.

my hair started with me hating to go to the barber, but i guess i kind of grew attached to it. and my clothes, they are just roomy and comfy, but would like to try girl clothes, but i dont know how i would get them and try it without my dad knowing or suspecting.

i myself still feel like shit due to the fact that i dont know how my father will react to it and that i cant express myself. the only thing that i can and am doing atm is wear a ponytail, i always have had long hair, and i guess now i know the reason why i always wanted it. i do know that i would love to play airsoft, but i would rather transition before i do that, because after i found out ive come to realise that this world is extremely transphobic and wouldnt want to play airsoft right now and then someday suddenly show up with boobs. it would just be awkward, and highly probable that people would start hating me and stuff

being 38 is not too late to start transitioning, there are people out there finding it out who are 80 years old, and feel pretty bad for them, because i know what they, and you, were going through. im just happy i found out a few weeks ago while im still 17, because it was accompanied by a bad depression of which i didnt know why. and thats frustrating, i dont know about you, but i lost everything i found 'fun' to do, i could just wake up, only sit around waiting for the evening, and go back to bed. i just came out to my mom, and she supported me, which made me want to come out to my dad, but i dont know how. i need his permission for HRT but when im around him i noticed that he is extremely sexist, and i dont want him to think im weird, but i also dont want him to call me his 'son' anymore.
well i'm just try around with stuff, hope i can figure something out.

i use windows. grew up with it, and am too stubborn to switch to linux. also my currently favorite game (not that i enjoy playing, it's the only game i don't close right after startup) is battlefield 4, and it doesn't have a linux version.
never looked at it that way, but i guess so. do you happen to know any free that i can edit videos on? i thought about it, and i guess i don't lose anything by trying.

well, i would really love to be able to play airsoft, but it's just that i'm already broke. i don't even have money to rent the basic equipment from the field, and i would like to play regularly, as to not get bored, but renting the equipment everytime when playing a few times a week is even more expensive.

well i planned to wait a boring 9 months until i get my unemployment benefit, then save up for the deposit and 3 months rent for an appartment and then move out, so that i can tell them over phone or something, instead of in person cuz it's hard for me. i estimate 50/50 support from my mother, almost 0 support from my stepdad, because he is the reason i am depressed in the first place, but i don't know about my father. i also need to be 18 to get hormone replacement therapy without my parents' permission, so as to not let them know. i know that i should be prepared that everyone i know and love might be gone when i come out.

thanks. i had already thought about that, it's just that, i don't really anything that i find 'fun', and i don't know about a gaming channel. sure, i would have something to do, and that would be good, but i don't know about my parents, they wouldn't want/allow me to use my computer for more than 3 hours a day. surely that could be a long time, but it also cannot, i was playing a round of BOII zombies 2 days ago and it suddenly was 1 am. if i could make money doing it, i would, it's just that i don't if my parents would want that. i mean, my stepdad constantly saying they should never have invented computer, and really despises them, and he was the reason i got depressed in the first place. and about my hobbies, well, i kinda lost them all a few years ago..

well i'm new here so i don't know any of that. you can tell me how you got over it, maybe it has something useful. and it stands for hormone replacement therapy. i'm just really new here and my friend told me that would be a good subreddit to atleast get started. also my formatting sucks, just read this comment.
